title: sync-packageset-kernel: sync kernel packageset to the kernel-team kernel-series data
commit_message:
sync-packageset-kernel: sync kernel packageset to the kernel-team kernel-series data
    
Signed-off-by: Andy Whitcroft <email address hidden>

+import sys
+from argparse import ArgumentParser
+from functools import cached_property
+
+from launchpadlib.launchpad import Launchpad
+from lazr.restfulclient.errors import NotFound
+
+from ktl.kernel_series import KernelSeries
+
+class UpdatePackageSet:
+
+    def __init__(self, series, packageset, launchpad=None):
+        self.series_name = series
+        self.packageset_name = packageset
+
+        if launchpad is not None:
+            self.launchpad = launchpad
+
+    @cached_property
+    def launchpad(self):
+        return Launchpad.login_with('sync-packageset-kernel', 'production', version="devel")
+
+    @cached_property
+    def series(self):
+        try:
+            return self.launchpad.distributions["ubuntu"].getSeries(name_or_version=self.series_name)
+        except NotFound:
+            return None
+
+    def series_is_devel(self):
+        return self.series.status not in ("Current Stable Release", "Supported", "Obsolete")
+
+    @cached_property
+    def packageset(self):
+        return self.launchpad.packagesets.getByName(name=self.packageset_name, distroseries=self.series)
+
+    def update_sources(self, dry_run=True):
+        if self.series is None:
+            print("ERROR: --series is not recognised by Launchpad.", file=sys.stderr)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        currentSet = set(self.packageset.getSourcesIncluded())
+
+        # Drop the existing members matching the prefix ...
+        newSet = set([
+            'dkms',
+            'firmware-sof',
+            'linux-base',
+            'linux-firmware',
+            'linux-firmware-nonfree',
+            'lowlatency-kernel',
+            'ubuntu-drivers-common',
+            'wireless-regdb',
+        ])
+
+        ks = KernelSeries()
+        ks_series = ks.lookup_series(codename=self.series.name)
+        if ks_series is None:
+            print("ERROR: --series is not recognised in kernel-series.", file=sys.stderr)
+            sys.exit(1)
+        for ks_source in ks_series.sources:
+            if ks_source.supported or ks_source.development:
+                for ks_package in ks_source.packages:
+                    newSet.add(ks_package.name)
+
+        ubuntu = self.launchpad.distributions["ubuntu"]
+
+        # Sync the packageset to the new set ...
+        print(f"PackageSet: {self.series_name} {self.packageset_name} {len(currentSet)} existing entries")
+        additions = list(newSet-currentSet)
+        additions.sort()
+        additions_present = []
+        additions_missing = []
+        for i in additions:
+            src = ubuntu.getSourcePackage(name=i)
+            if src is None:
+                additions_missing.append(i)
+            else:
+                additions_present.append(i)
+        if len(additions_missing):
+            print("Requested (but not in distribution):")
+            for i in additions_missing:
+                print(" * %s" % i)
+        print("Additions:" )
+        for i in additions_present:
+            print(" * %s" % i)
+        print("Removals:" )
+        removals = list(currentSet-newSet)
+        removals.sort()
+        for i in removals:
+            print(" * %s" % i)
+
+        if not dry_run:
+            if additions:
+                self.packageset.addSources(names=additions)
+            if removals:
+                self.packageset.removeSources(names=removals)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+
+    parser = ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--series", help="series-name to update.")
+    parser.add_argument("--package-set", help="package-set name to update.", default="kernel")
+    parser.add_argument("-y", "--yes", help="perform the update", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if args.series is None:
+        print("ERROR: --series is required.", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    update_package_set = UpdatePackageSet(args.series, args.package_set)
+    update_package_set.update_sources(dry_run=not args.yes)
